seo.title: Water Mitigation Estimating App | deltaV
seo.description: A field app for water-damage restoration: dispatch to a priced, signed estimate on the first visit, every line backed by a reading or photo.
faq: Does it replace our estimating software?
No. It captures readings, photos and signatures in the field so the estimate you send is complete and backed up.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. It is built for technicians on site.
How does it help with adjusters?
Every line item carries the reading or photo behind it, so the estimate explains itself.
